name: Deuteronomy
lede: The fifth book of the Bible, in full: Moses' words to Israel in the plains of Moab, every one in the words of the ASV.

books.name: These Are the Words
books.blurb: In the fortieth year, beyond the Jordan, Moses begins to declare the law: Horeb, the judges, the spies and the evil report at Kadesh-barnea, the defeat at Hormah, the long way round Seir, Moab and Ammon, and Sihon king of Heshbon delivered up.

books.name: Take Heed to Thyself
books.blurb: Og king of Bashan and his bedstead of iron; the land beyond the Jordan given to Reuben, Gad and half Manasseh; Moses' prayer to go over, and Pisgah; ye saw no manner of form on the day that Jehovah spake unto you in Horeb; a devouring fire, a jealous God; and the cities of refuge beyond the Jordan.

books.name: Hear, O Israel
books.blurb: The covenant made at Horeb and the ten commandments spoken out of the midst of the fire; go thou near, and hear; Hear, O Israel: Jehovah our God is one Jehovah, and thou shalt love Jehovah thy God with all thy heart; the words upon the door-posts; and when thy son asketh thee in time to come.

books.name: A People for His Own Possession
books.blurb: Seven nations greater and mightier than thou, and the hornet sent before thee; Jehovah set his love upon you, not because ye were more in number; the manna and the forty years — man doth not live by bread only; and a good land of wheat and barley, vines and fig-trees and pomegranates: beware lest thou forget.

books.name: The Tables of Stone
books.blurb: Not for thy righteousness: the golden calf at Horeb remembered, the tables cast down and broken, Moses fallen down before Jehovah forty days and forty nights; the tables hewn again and put in the ark; and now, Israel, what doth Jehovah thy God require of thee?

books.name: The Place of His Name
books.blurb: A land of hills and valleys that drinketh water of the rain of heaven; lay up these my words in your heart; I set before you this day a blessing and a curse, on Gerizim and on Ebal; and the place which Jehovah your God shall choose out of all your tribes, to put his name there.

books.name: The Year of Release
books.blurb: The prophet and the dreamer of dreams that saith, Let us go after other gods; ye are the children of Jehovah your God; the clean and the unclean; the tithe; at the end of every seven years a release, for the poor shall never cease out of the land; the Hebrew servant; and the firstlings.

books.name: Justice, Only Justice
books.blurb: Three times in a year: the passover, the feast of weeks and the feast of tabernacles; judges and officers in all thy gates — justice, only justice; the matter too hard, the king that shall write him a copy of this law, the portion of the priests, the abominations of the nations, and a prophet like unto me.

books.name: When Thou Goest Forth to Battle
books.blurb: The cities of refuge, thy neighbor's landmark and the two witnesses; when thou goest forth to battle, be not afraid; the fruit-trees in a siege; the one found slain in the field; the captive woman, the right of the first-born, the stubborn son, and him that is hanged on a tree.

books.name: Thou Shalt Not
books.blurb: Thy brother's ox gone astray, a battlement for thy roof, no mingled seed or stuff, fringes upon the four borders; the laws of marriage; who shall not enter into the assembly of Jehovah; the camp kept holy; the servant that is escaped, usury, vows, and thy neighbor's vineyard.

books.name: The Basket of First-fruits
books.blurb: The bill of divorcement, the millstone taken to pledge, the hired servant's wages, the sheaf forgotten in the field for the sojourner, the fatherless and the widow; the ox that treadeth out the grain; just weights; remember what Amalek did; and the basket of first-fruits: A Syrian ready to perish was my father.

books.name: The Blessings and the Curses
books.blurb: Great stones plastered and written with all the words of this law, and an altar of unhewn stones on mount Ebal; six tribes on Gerizim to bless and six on Ebal for the curse, and all the people shall say, Amen; blessed shalt thou be in the city and in the field — and if thou wilt not hearken, all these curses.

books.name: Choose Life
books.blurb: The covenant in the land of Moab; the secret things belong unto Jehovah; I have set before thee life and death, the blessing and the curse: therefore choose life; Moses a hundred and twenty years old, and Joshua charged to be strong and of good courage; the law written in a book and laid by the side of the ark.

books.name: The Song of Moses
books.blurb: Give ear, ye heavens, and I will speak: the Rock, his work is perfect; as an eagle that stirreth up her nest; but Jeshurun waxed fat, and kicked; vengeance is mine; see now that I, even I, am he — and Moses bidden to go up mount Nebo and see the land, and die there.
